_comment: Copy this file to config/config.local.json and fill in the values, or let `python scripts/setup.py` write it for you. config.local.json is git-ignored and must never be committed.

setup._comment: How this machine is set up: 'company' (an IT-provided opencode.json points OpenCode at an internal gateway) or 'private' (OpenCode logs in to a provider account of your own). Written by the setup wizard.

runtime._comment: Where the audit trail and OpenCode debug output are written. Never cleared by any tool. Empty means no audit trail.

knowledge._comment: The board's knowledge source: a folder of Markdown notes, such as an Obsidian vault. Read for every question, written to only after you confirm a memory entry when closing a topic. token_budget caps how many tokens of notes are sent per model call. Empty vault_path means the board answers from your question alone. roles_subfolder is the folder inside the vault holding one role profile per member (section 3.4); it is excluded from the ranked selection and read on every run.

server._comment: The browser interface listens on 127.0.0.1 only.

provider._comment: models.board is the provider/model string OpenCode expects, e.g. 'anthropic/claude-opus-5' for a private account, or whatever provider/model your company's opencode.json defines. endpoint is only a record of which endpoint was approved (AI-3); it is not read per call. token_limits.board null means no limit is observed. opencode.config_file points at a company-provided opencode.json and is passed as OPENCODE_CONFIG (OC-8); leave empty for a private setup. opencode.auto_approve adds --auto where the installed version has it (OC-6, OC-7). opencode.extra_args appends further arguments to every run, one string per argument, e.g. --agent plan (OC-9).
